about.label: About
about.title:
DIGITAL MATTER,
HUMAN TOUCH.
about.p1: I'm Numa — a designer, artist, researcher, and educator based in Brazil. My work sits at the intersection of emerging technologies and cultural practice, with a particular focus on blockchain ecosystems and multimedia applications.
about.p2: On the practice side, I work with visual communication, branding, digital products, creative direction, webdesign, audiovisual production, illustration, and 3D modeling. I build visual identities, soundtracks, videos, and diverse digital experiences.
about.p3: I also develop educational content, workshops, and courses on blockchain for different levels of familiarity — from beginners to professionals seeking to deepen their knowledge.

portfolio.label: Portfolio
portfolio.title: HIGHLIGHTS.
portfolio.flui_desc: A prototype platform that transforms on-chain data into clear financial information, facilitating income organization and reporting.
portfolio.threeland_desc: Creative hub for cyberspace — a studio that grew from a 3D metaverse into a cNFT marketplace and open-source tooling.
portfolio.web3pe_desc: At WEB3PE 2025 (IFPE, Belo Jardim — Pernambuco), I presented the lecture "Cripto&Sociedade", ran a wallet-creation workshop that also explained how block validation works on Solana, and hosted a conversation circle on crypto art.
portfolio.cfa_desc: Visual identity for my master's project. 2 years of research, supervision of 3 undergraduate students, developing in-person and virtual educational content.
portfolio.camapu_desc: My artwork featured in the "Held in Motion" section of the Interlace exhibition at ArtVerse Paris, produced by Mallow and Exchange.art.
portfolio.logofolio_desc: Logos developed for various clients, in different fields of activity, over the years.
portfolio.gatenu_desc: My first collection in Solana, released in 2022 and with more than 70 collaborations.

areas.label: What I do
areas.title:
AREAS
OF WORK.
areas.design_desc: Visual communication, branding, digital product, and creative direction. From identity systems to interface design, phygital graphics.
areas.art_desc: Digital and traditional art, blending fantasy and cultural symbols with a dreamlike nature. On-chain works exhibited in Brasil, France and Thailand.
areas.music_desc: Music for various purposes. Soundtracks for films and games, DJing, sound design, remixes, and production of original instrumentals for artists.
areas.edu_desc: Development of educational materials, workshops, lectures, and courses on blockchain — designed for different levels of prior knowledge.

education.label: Education
education.title:
BUILD AND

education.intro: I'm available for lectures, workshops, mentorships, and educational collaborations — especially with universities and research groups. These are usually open initiatives, but I'm open to proposals for something tailored or more institutional.
education.wiki_desc: A free open knowledge base on blockchain, Web3, crypto art, and emerging technologies — written in clear, accessible language. A living resource for curious minds at any level.
education.lw_desc: Presentations with hands-on activities on specific blockchain topics that can be adapted for diverse audiences and objectives. Cryptoart, design, development, basic practices, etc.
education.m_desc: Individual or group mentoring for professionals and students who wish to enter or improve their knowledge of Web3. Focus on practice, technical literacy, career guidance, and community development.

teaching.label: Lectures & Workshops
teaching.title: TEACHING.
teaching.intro: Lectures, courses, mentorships, and workshops on blockchain, Web3, and crypto art — for universities, research groups, communities, and events, in person and online.

publications.label: Academic Output
publications.title: PUBLICATIONS.
publications.diss_desc: Master's dissertation investigating pedagogical frameworks for teaching blockchain, NFTs, and Web3 to diverse audiences. Developed at UFPE, it bridges design education and emerging digital technologies.
publications.paper1_title: At the frontier of the metaverse: NFTs, artistic expression, and digital immersions
publications.paper1_desc: Explores NFTs beyond digital art tokenization, examining the tension between artistic autonomy and commercialization in Web3. Published in the Metaverse journal (2024), with case studies from immersive exhibitions.
publications.paper2_title: Metaverse and cultural preservation: an alternative through NFTs of social sustainability in Brazil
publications.paper2_desc: Presented at SVR'23, this paper investigates how NFTs and metaverse platforms can be used to preserve and promote Indigenous cultural heritage through authorship assurance.
publications.ch_desc: Chapter from the collection of short courses from the WebMedia 2024 event. Translates blockchain and NFT concepts into an accessible educational language, result of my master's degree on teaching Web3 through artistic and design practice.

art.hero_desc: I conjure hybrid creatures from a dreamlike, intensely colorful universe — fantasy, culture, and mainly Brazilian fauna and flora woven together. On-chain and off, from graffiti walls to virtual reality.
art.stat_countries: Countries · BR · FR · DE · NL · AT · TH · CA
art.p1: I'm Numa, a Brazilian crypto artist and visual artist. I've drawn for as long as I can remember, and that instinct grew into a whole visual language: an oneiric, extremely colorful universe where fantasy, culture, and mainly Brazilian fauna and flora merge into hybrid creatures.
art.p2: My practice moves fluidly across mediums — drawing and graffiti, handmade sculpture, 3D, and virtual reality. The same beings that live on a wall find new form on-chain and inside immersive worlds.
art.p3: My work has been exhibited both in the metaverse and in person, across several states in Brazil and internationally — in France, Germany, the Netherlands, Austria, Thailand, and Canada.
art.m1_desc: Where every creature is born — line, character, and color first.
art.m2_desc: The universe scaled up to walls and public space.
art.m3_desc: Handmade and digital — creatures made physical.
art.m4_desc: Immersive, walk-in versions of the same colorful world.
art.exhib_intro: Shown in the metaverse and in person — across several states in Brazil and in France, Germany, the Netherlands, Austria, Thailand, and Canada.
art.hl1_desc: My piece “Camapu” showed in mallow.art's “Held in Motion” at Interlace, ArtVerse Paris — chosen by sponsor Pine Stake to represent them.
art.hl2_desc: 2023: works on show, a panel on art, NFTs & multi-hyphenate careers, and a closing-party DJ set. 2024: pieces from the “Symmetrisch Energie” collection.
art.hl3_desc: A crypto-art exhibition & tech event I produced at Casa Criatura — funded by 100+ Solana NFTs, backed by the Solana Foundation, Kanna Coin, Estelita & collectors. Featured artist talks, an intro-to-blockchain class I taught, live sets by Tagore & Barbarize, and my own DJ set.
art.hl4_title: Pioneering Brazilian Art on the Blockchain
art.hl4_desc: An exhibition celebrating pioneering Brazilian art on the blockchain, held at Casa Nua, São Paulo.
art.hl5_desc: Part of “Delírios Digitais” — a hybrid (in-person & on-chain) edition of the Digital Art Biennial at Oi Futuro, Rio de Janeiro.
art.hl6_desc: A group showcase of Brazilian NFT artists during NFT Rio, held at the Escola de Artes Visuais do Parque Lage.
art.collect_intro: Original creatures, minted on-chain across two ecosystems.

visualid.lede: Eight years of marks, wordmarks, and brand systems — built for startups, artists, collectives, and Web3 projects. This is a wide sweep across many clients, not a deep dive into a few.
visualid.ov_body: Building a logo is only the start — a mark has to live everywhere. Across dozens of projects I've designed identities and carried them into real applications: social, print, merch, packaging, product, and events. This case study is about range — the sheer number of brands, styles, and contexts I've worked through.
visualid.wall_body: A selection of marks across many industries and visual registers — from playful and hand-drawn to strict and geometric. Each square is one identity.
visualid.wild_body: Where the identities actually show up — social and digital, print and merch, packaging, and beyond. Each square is a real application from a different project.
visualid.eco_label: A few of the brands & projects
visualid.cta_body: From a single logo to a full identity system with every application ready to ship.

land3.lede: A studio that grew from a 3D metaverse into a multilingual cNFT marketplace, open-source tooling, and an on-chain game. I was its first hire — and helped give every launch one visual language.
land3.ov_p1: 3.land was a Web3 product studio that prototyped, launched, and refined solutions on the Solana network. As the first employee, I enriched and solidified the studio's visual identity through multimedia graphics and multidisciplinary work.
land3.ov_p3: It was a journey that spanned various approaches alongside an international, creative, and proactive team.
land3.role_body: As the studio's first employee, I wore many hats. Over four years my role spanned direction, production, and the systems that kept a small team shipping fast.
land3.r1_p: Set the visual direction for launches and campaigns — key visuals, logos, banners, and card art — keeping every product on one language.
land3.r2_p: Designed and built the studio's landing page — an interactive one-pager tying the whole identity together.
land3.r3_p: Working alongside two other artists, I animated and rendered the studio's 3D graphics — from the alien mascot to 3D logos and scene art. They led the modeling; I focused on final production, jumping into modeling myself when needed.
land3.r4_p: Edited promo videos, event recaps, and interviews — cutting footage, animating, and building sound design from a custom SFX library.
land3.r5_p: Collaborated on the social media strategy — content planning, campaign rollouts, and milestone moments.
land3.r6_p: Part of a small, international team — two co-founders (project management and engineering), another developer, two 3D artists, and a product designer. Beyond the visuals, I set up the company's first file-organization system and introduced Trello to structure communication — a workflow the developers later adopted as well.
land3.studio_body: Five hackathon wins in two years, an immersive 3D metaverse, and a multilingual cNFT marketplace — the products and milestones I helped ship, and the graphics that carried each one.

cfa.lede: "Computers Make Art" — the visual identity and teaching material I built for my master's research: a free, art-rooted introduction to blockchain, NFTs, and Web3, made for the people this field usually leaves out.
cfa.s1_body: The palette of fluorescent pink, purple, lilac and lime yellow isn't just decorative, it's mine. It's the same chromatic language present in my own artwork, so bringing these colors into the project is a natural extension of my identity. Beyond that personal signature, it gave the project a distinct visual identity and let me approach technology with artistic sensibility and a social lens, moving away from the cold, usual aesthetic of the crypto world.
cfa.s2_body: I wanted something organic and full of movement, expressive and impossible to ignore. I brought in fluid shapes, hand-drawn lettering, generous spacing and playful infographics that turn complex ideas into something people can absorb easily. The design is part of the pedagogy, not just packaging for it.
cfa.r21_p: Custom diagrams turn abstract concepts — how a blockchain transaction works, metadata, seed phrases — into concrete, relatable pictures. Simple infographics do the pedagogical heavy lifting.
cfa.r22_p: Slides drawn from the many classes derived from the project — the same warm visual language carried into every session.
cfa.r23_p: I created a handmade notebook to gather seed phrases in one place. People usually write these phrases down anywhere, often on loose scraps of paper. Hardware wallets come with a small sheet, but almost no one has an organized physical spot dedicated to all their wallets. I first made it for the students I worked with during my master's. Today I also make them as gifts for people I meet at in-person events. Turning something abstract and intimidating into an object you can hold in your hands and find beautiful.
cfa.s3_body: Social posts and event art that carried the identity into recruitment and outreach — for the free course, its open lectures, and academic appearances like the WebMedia 2024 minicourse.
cfa.s4_body: I've always been involved with social movements and education. I was already running educational and community actions long before I entered the blockchain world. My research is the evolution of what I already did: using education as a tool for autonomy and care. Blockchain is the subject I'm immersed in right now, but my commitment to making knowledge accessible has always been the same.
cfa.comm_p1: Built alongside activist-educators Débora Aguiar and Manu Marques, the course paired blockchain fundamentals with lessons on decoloniality and financial education — and brought in trans, Black, and non-binary NFT artists to make the field feel close, not distant.
cfa.comm_p2: With academic guidance from João Marcelo Teixeira (master's advisor) and Leonardo Castillo (who invited Numa to teach Design para Web3 at UFPE), and the scientific-initiation students who researched alongside the project — Milena Gomes (Pedagogy), Vitória Farias (Design), and Artur Couto (Computer Science, in memoriam).
cfa.tl1_d: Seven experimental sessions — from a graffiti mutirão with VR headsets to design-school lectures — testing pedagogy and shaping the material before it existed as a finished object.
cfa.tl2_d: Three undergraduates from Computer Science, Design, and Pedagogy validated the material, 3D-scanned paper sculptures, and minted their own NFTs on 3.land — later co-authoring a paper at XR4EDU / IMX 2025.
cfa.tl3_d: 33 applications, eight in-person lessons, meals and printed material provided. A warmly received introduction to Web3 with critical debate at its center.
cfa.tl4_d: The material travelled: WebMedia 2024 minicourse, NFT Brasil at the São Paulo Biennial, IslandDAO in Koh Samui (Thailand), and an intensive at UFSJ — each adapting the same visual system.
cfa.quote_p: Design here is not decoration — it is mediation. A warmer, more organic language became the bridge between complex technology and the people it too often excludes.
cfa.wiki_p: Everything taught during the research — Blockchain, Web3, NFTs and digital art communities — lives in an open wiki I keep updating.
cfa.cta_body: Identity, illustration, and editorial systems built to make hard ideas feel human.
